messages.subject: rhdfs hdfs.init() error
parts:
Hi, I have previously installed rhdfs with Hadoop 0.20.2-cdh3u3, but  When I run hdfs.init(), I got the error as:

> library(rhdfs)
Loading required package: rJava

HADOOP_CMD=/home/hadoop1/hadoop-cdh3/bin/hadoop

Be sure to run hdfs.init()
> hdfs.init()
/usr/bin/env: bash: No such file or directory
Error in system(command, intern = TRUE) : error in running command
>
